shared_elements: bearded male human figures in profile
low-relief horizontal frieze on a single ground line
figures all facing the same direction
stylised curled beard and hair rendered as regular rows of curls
justification: Both are continuous low-relief friezes of strictly profile bearded men in tall caps with weapons, with beards and hair rendered as regular rows of tight curls, which is a fairly specific shared convention. But the subjects differ sharply: A is a dynamic hunt with a horse-drawn chariot, an archer drawing his bow and attacking lions, while B is a static procession of robed dignitaries touching one another and carrying no game or animals at all.
